acceptance: Decision recorded on whether connection setup belongs in Ts (spec-justified), and the timing window matches it
Exported per-stream timestamps are wall-clock times, with durations still from the monotonic clock
Phase start/end and duration describe the same interval
context: 2026-10-04 throughput adversarial review (develop 8ed0c64e1). Timestamp conversion confirmed by two reviewers.
description:
Stream start_time is taken before `connection_factory()` (connect, SET statements, configure_for_benchmark) and end_time after `close()` (tpch/throughput_test.py:401,419,557-568; tpcds/throughput_test.py:655,670,725-728). Independent-connection setup therefore inflates Total Test Time and deflates Throughput@Size.

Per-stream start/end times are perf_counter() values, which result_capture.py:1661-1662 and :1748-1755 pass to datetime.fromtimestamp, producing dates like 1970-01-02. The phase-level start time also includes pre-generation, while duration_ms does not.
